preserve: Stored memberships and configurations remain the sole membership/configuration store; absent configuration uses the current label DATA defaults.
Events remain label=event rows in space-membership; RSVPs remain space-member rows keyed by membership_id and relay.
Rule-joined membership requires active member state and the existing free, owner-held access, or invitation evidence paths; only the shared permission owner decides actions.
Reads and writes use the run records door with expected-value compare-and-swap; event revision serializes last-seat RSVP races.
Missing and denied membership map to 404 and 403; unavailable accepted-request evidence remains 503.
allowed_deltas: Async records-door reads and atomic writes replace retired SQL access.
Default rules are inserted only after confirmed absence; conflict returns the actual stored winner.
The legacy accepted-request proof has no current records-backed owner. Its binding is omitted; admitted_by_invitation remains honored, and only paths needing the missing proof fail unavailable.
banned_substitutions: Any parallel membership, configuration, request or permission store.
A network-request record kind without an existing owner, or intake-request records treated as join evidence.
Caller account_id, grant_person or input relay/holds as native authority.
roles[*].may as a substitute for the shared deny-wins permission engine.
Treating existing-row CAS as a collection fence for concurrent own-member-type insertions.

baseline.active_retention_source: Only the adapter target is eligible for retention checks; the nine .held artifacts are immutable source evidence, not active implementation.
